title: Failure criterion for the split search
statement: For natural numbers $C,c,m$, the exponential split search at length $m$ returns no value if and only if there is no natural number $n$ such that $n+C\cdot 2^{(n+1)^c}=m$.
replaced: For natural numbers $C, c$ and $m$, the exponential split search at length $m$ fails if and only if no natural number $n$ satisfies $n + C \cdot 2^{(n+1)^c} = m$.
